LightningComponentBundle.description: Upload visiting-card image; optionally pick an Account so new contacts attach to it. Outputs Content Document Id and Account Id for Flow.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record ID (optional)
property.description: If set, the uploaded file is linked to this record (for example Visit__c). Leave blank to store the file for the running user only.

property.name: defaultAccountId
property.label: Default Account Id (optional)
property.description: When set (e.g. from a prior Flow Lookup), pre-fills the Account output without searching.

property.name: titleGrad
property.label: Title (gradient part)
property.description: Second heading segment with accent styling.

property.name: hintText
property.label: Hint text
property.default: Upload a clear photo. Later steps can scan multiple cards from this image.

property.name: fileTitle
property.label: File title (optional)
property.description: Title stored in Salesforce Files. Defaults to the original file name.

property.name: requireUploadBeforeNext
property.label: Require upload before Next
property.description: When true, the Flow Next control stays disabled until an upload succeeds.

property.name: contentDocId
property.label: Content Document Id
property.description: Output: the 15- or 18-character ContentDocument Id returned after a successful upload. Map this attribute to a Flow Text variable (or formula) and use it in Get Records, Apex, or subflows.

property.name: accountId
property.label: Account Id
property.description: Output: Account selected in the screen (18-character Id). Map to a Flow Text variable and pass to Create Contacts from Visiting Card JSON so contacts are created under this Account.
